author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: 1.9.7 - a scan can finish reading every app and device and still schedule one more background step to build the finished map; that scheduled call occasionally fails to fire (a known Hubitat scheduler flakiness this app has hit before), which can make a finished scan look stuck for several minutes with nothing telling it to wrap up. A recovery for this already existed, but it only ran when the app's own settings page happened to reload - watching the map page instead, or a backgrounded browser tab, meant nothing triggered it until the settings page was reopened by hand, exactly what two independent testers hit this week. The /scan-status endpoint (already documented as the stuck-scan troubleshooting check) now runs that same recovery before responding, so any status check can un-stick a scan, not only a settings-page reload. Also added: the map page now uses Cloudflare Web Analytics to count anonymous visits, disclosed under Requirements and limitations in the README - no cookies, no personal or device data, by Cloudflare's own design it cannot identify who opened the page, only that it was opened.
